plugins.name: contexture
plugins.description: Architectural rules primed before coding, a review pass after, safety hooks, and a spec-to-ship workflow.

plugins.name: contexture-lite
plugins.description: Smaller contexture for local or small-context models: the rules, memory, review, and debugging skills only.

plugins.name: contexture-ui
plugins.description: Work pane and status line for contexture: files, plan steps and the rules primed this session, beside the chat.

nowLine.title: Now line
nowLine.description: Show what the session waits on (you, a tool, a subagent, Claude) and for how long, above the prompt.

focusColors.title: Focus colors
focusColors.description: Color the desktop and mobile apps like ClauDeck's Focus look. Replaces the app's own colors while on.

openAtStart.title: Open at session start
openAtStart.description: Open the Work panel at every session start in the desktop app, VS Code and mobile, even with no slug in flight or after you closed it.
